From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Seed MAP + acceptance timeline & onboarding slides for Paxion pilot

Hi Alex / Paxion team —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation I drafted a compact MAP (Mutual Action Plan) to align on evaluation milestones and a short path to a pilot decision. I kept it outcome-oriented: technical gating, success criteria, and an onboarding week0 checklist that should help your engineers try a small inference workload and validate latency/cost.

What I'm sharing:
- map_template_collab_v1.gdoc (link below) — editable doc with acceptance matrix and weekly milestones
- week0_onboarding_slides.pptx — 2-slide checklist for engineering to run the first smoke tests
- acceptance_matrix_v1.xlsx — simple pass/fail table for core tests (latency, throughput, privacy model)

Asks:
1) Can you confirm which environments you'd want the pilot to run in (AWS us-west-2 vs GCP us-central) and whether data residency is a hard requirement?
2) Please add missing stakeholders to the doc and flag any additional non-functional requirements (e.g., SOC2 evidence).

Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ABCxyz_map_seed (editable), https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/2SLIDE_map_onboarding

Next proposed timeline (flexible):
- Week 0: setup & onboarding (engineers run smoke tests)
- Week 1–2: focused eval (latency/cost/quality)
- Week 3: acceptance review & decision

I'll loop in our technical owners to help with environment and test design.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: map_template_collab_v1.gdoc (doc stub), week0_onboarding_slides.pptx (pptx stub), acceptance_matrix_v1.xlsx (xlsx stub)

Thanks Camila — this looks good and concise. A couple of notes from our side:

- Data residency: legal requires that PHI-derived telemetry stays in us-east-1 for now. Is that an option for the pilot?
- Compliance: could you add a short SOC2 evidence checklist to the MAP? We’ll need to confirm logs/audit availability before the pilot.
- Success criteria: can we add an item for "99th percentile token latency < 300ms" for the smoke test? We might be flexible on mean latency but need the tail defined.

I'll add a few stakeholders to the doc (SRE and Security) and mark the decision owner.

—Alex

Adding the Week 0 checklist inline and attaching a tiny slide deck for SRE:

Week 0 checklist (engineer-run):
- Provision test instance (us-east-1); confirm IAM role & KMS access
- Run sample ingest of 10k tokens across 5 requests; capture mean and 99th pct latency
- Validate KV cache behavior with repeated prompt prefixes (3 repeats)
- Run throughput test (concurrent 4 clients) and record tokens/sec
- Verify logs are sent to ephemeral S3 bucket and retention is set to 30 days

Pass criteria (Week 0 smoke):
- 99th percentile latency < 300ms or documented mitigation plan
- Throughput not less than 60% of expected baseline for chosen instance type
- Audit logs present and KMS key accessible to Paxion security for read-only verification

Attachments: week0_onboarding_slides.pptx (2 slides: runbook + quick test commands)

I also added a short "escalation" row in the acceptance matrix to capture what we do if the tail latency misses the gate.

—Marissa
